qualifier: lysosomal ganglioside degradation
name: Sphingolipid synthesis and lysosomal glycosphingolipid degradation
rationale: Members cover ceramide/sphingomyelin synthesis and homeostasis plus glycosphingolipid and ganglioside synthesis, transport and lysosomal catabolism (GM2 gangliosidoses, sialidosis), unlike confusables centred on GPI anchors, amide or phospholipid transfer.

qualifier: YAP/TAZ transcription and cell density sensing
name: Hippo–YAP/TAZ signalling and cell density sensing
rationale: All members concern Hippo pathway regulation and YAP1/TAZ-driven transcription with contact-inhibition sensing, distinct from RUNX3, WNT, PDGF and PTK6 neighbours.

core: GDP-fucose and CMP-sialic acid supply for glycosylation
qualifier: SLC35C1/SLC35A1 transporter defects
name: GDP-fucose synthesis and fucose/sialic acid nucleotide-sugar transport defects
rationale: Members are GDP-fucose biosynthesis plus CDGs from the Golgi GDP-fucose (SLC35C1) and CMP-sialic acid (SLC35A1) transporters, unlike confusables with other SLC35 defects or blood-group fucosylation.

qualifier: cholesterol synthesis control and fatty acid nutrient response
name: SREBP-regulated cholesterol synthesis and fatty acid nutrient response
rationale: Members centre on SREBP signalling, cholesterol biosynthesis control and fatty acid, fructose and caloric-restriction responses, unlike PPAR/LXR nuclear-receptor or cholesterol-transport neighbours.

qualifier: target programmes in hematopoiesis and signalling
name: RUNX1-centred transcriptional regulation and its target gene programmes
rationale: Nearly all members are RUNX1 (with RUNX2/3) regulation and its target programmes in myeloid, megakaryocyte, keratinocyte, BCR, WNT and estrogen-receptor contexts, unlike Hox/TFAP2, erythroid-megakaryocyte or FLT3 neighbours.

qualifier: PTEN control and AKT/mTORC2 activation
name: PTEN regulation and AKT/mTORC2 activation
rationale: Members cover PTEN stability and localization, AKT activation (TORC2, AKT1 E17K) and AKT target phosphorylation, unlike neighbours on PTEN ceRNA loss-of-function or nuclear phosphoinositides.

qualifier: severing, capping and crosslinking
name: Actin filament severing, capping and network crosslinking
rationale: Members concern actin severing, depolymerization, barbed-end capping, crosslinking and caspase cleavage of cytoskeletal proteins, unlike neighbours on filopodia, lamellipodia, Arp2/3 or focal adhesions.

qualifier: VEGFR2, neuropilin and Tie2 signalling
name: Endothelial specification and VEGFR2/Tie2 signalling in vessel development
rationale: Members cover endothelial fate and arterial/venous/lymphatic differentiation with VEGF-VEGFR2-neuropilin and Tie2 signalling, unlike sprouting-angiogenesis regulation or BMP-driven cardiac vascular neighbours.

qualifier: precursor processing
name: Interleukin-1 precursor processing and IL-1 alpha production
rationale: All three members concern processing of IL-1 cytokine precursors and IL-1 alpha production, unlike IL-17, inflammasome/pyroptosis or IL-18 neighbours.

qualifier: linkage-specific chain types and DUB families
name: Linkage-specific ubiquitin chain assembly and deubiquitination
rationale: Members are E1/E2/E3 ubiquitination of specific chain linkages (K6, K11, K27, K29, K48, K63, branched) and DUB families, without the proteasome, autophagy, NF-kB or neddylation content of neighbours.

qualifier: downstream second messengers, PKC/NF-kB and IL-2
name: Downstream antigen-receptor signalling to PKC, NF-κB and IL-2
rationale: Members cover downstream TCR (and BCR NF-kB) signalling via second messengers, ITK/PKC and IL-2 output, lacking the CD28 costimulation, proximal CD3/ZAP-70 and non-canonical NF-kB content of neighbours.

qualifier: epithelial–mesenchymal signalling in lung and salivary gland
name: Epithelial–mesenchymal signalling in lung and salivary branching morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern lung and salivary gland branching, mesenchymal/epithelial proliferation and reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal signalling, unlike neighbours on trachea, pneumocytes or prostate branching.

qualifier: store-operated entry and ER calcium release
name: Store-operated calcium entry and ER calcium release
rationale: Members concern raising cytosolic Ca2+ by SOCE, release of sequestered ER calcium (including caffeine/ryanodine-type release) and Ca2+ sensing, unlike neighbours on Ca2+ reuptake, Na/Ca exchange or cardiac contraction.

qualifier: E2F transcription and replication origin licensing
name: E2F-driven G1/S transcription and replication origin licensing
rationale: Members combine E2F target transcription with ORC/CDC6 pre-replicative complex assembly, replication initiation and replication-stress checkpoints, unlike neighbours on DREAM repression, T-cell division or DNA repair.

core: Regulation of death-receptor and necrotic cell death
qualifier: necroptosis, autophagic death and tumor-cell killing
name: Regulation of death-receptor apoptosis, necroptosis and tumor-cell killing
rationale: Members are regulatory terms for TRAIL/TNF death-receptor apoptosis, necroptosis, autophagic death and anti-tumor defence, lacking the Fas/caspase-8, BCL2/mitochondrial and RIPK1 mechanism pathways of neighbours.

qualifier: capacitation, acrosome reaction and zona penetration
name: Sperm capacitation, acrosome reaction and zona pellucida penetration
rationale: All members concern sperm capacitation, acrosome biogenesis/exocytosis and binding/penetration of cumulus and zona pellucida, unlike sperm motility, germ cell or maternal-to-zygotic neighbours.

qualifier: DREAM/p130-mediated cell-cycle gene repression
name: G2/M transition and DREAM-repressed cell-cycle gene transcription
rationale: Members cover G2 phase, cyclin B/CDK1 and PLK events, the G2/M checkpoint and DREAM/p107/p130 control of E2F targets, unlike G1/S E2F activation or TP53-driven arrest neighbours.

qualifier: oncogenic RAF, MEK and RAS mutants
name: RAF–MEK–ERK activation including oncogenic RAF and MEK mutants
rationale: Members concern RAF activation and MAP2K/MAPK/RSK signalling including BRAF/RAF1 mutants, fusions and MRAS-SHOC2 complexes, unlike neighbours on RAS regulation by GAPs/SOS or ERK negative regulation.

qualifier: epoxygenase and omega-hydroxylase branches, ichthyosis defects
name: P450 epoxygenase and ω-hydroxylase lipid oxidation, ichthyosis defects
rationale: Members cover CYP-mediated epoxidation and omega-hydroxylation of fatty acids and eicosanoids (EET/DHET, 20-HETE) with ichthyosis-causing CYP4F22/SLC27A4 defects, unlike lipoxygenase, leukotriene or omega-oxidation catabolism neighbours.

qualifier: exocyst/RHOQ and GLUT4 translocation
name: Exocyst-mediated plasma membrane protein delivery including GLUT4 translocation
rationale: Members concern regulated Golgi-to-surface protein transport, exocyst tethering, RHOQ cycle and GLUT4 translocation, unlike apical/raft sorting, CFTR or glucose-import neighbours.

qualifier: T cell–dendritic cell interaction
name: Immunological synapse and T cell–dendritic cell interaction
rationale: Members cover T cell polarity, synapse and raft organization, lymphocyte aggregation and the antigen-presenting/IL-12 dendritic cell side, unlike neighbours on integrin migration, CD28-Vav1 or chemotaxis.

qualifier: N-glycan, GPI and glycolipid pathways with congenital disorders
name: N-glycan, GPI and glycolipid glycosylation and congenital glycosylation disorders
rationale: Members span dolichol-linked N-glycan synthesis, nucleotide-sugar supply and transport, GPI anchoring, glycosphingolipid and sialic acid metabolism and the CDGs of these steps, unlike proteoglycan/GAG, O-mannosyl or mucopolysaccharidosis neighbours.

qualifier: apical and membrane raft targeting
name: Polarized Golgi-to-surface sorting to apical and raft domains
rationale: Members concern apical and basolateral protein delivery, Golgi-to-plasma membrane transport and raft targeting, unlike CFTR, exocyst/GTPase or hepatobiliary transporter neighbours.

qualifier: IL-6, IL-8 and TNF output
name: Toll/IL-1 receptor regulation of IL-6, IL-8 and TNF production
rationale: Members regulate Toll and IL-1 signalling and production of IL-6, IL-8, TNF and IL-1 alpha, unlike neighbours on TLR3/4, CD40 or inflammasome regulation.

qualifier: IGF and peptide hormone response
name: Osteoclast differentiation and bone resorption with IGF response
rationale: Members cover osteoclast differentiation, fusion, proliferation and bone resorption plus IGF/peptide responses, unlike neighbours on macrophage fusion, osteoblasts or mineralization.
